description: This is a Java class named AuthService implementing authentication functionalities such as user registration and login, using Spring framework annotations and interacting with UserRepository and DTOs.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class for handling user authentication, registration, and login operations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Creates a new user with the provided registration details and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with the email and password, returning a login response if successful.
